summary.scaling: classical MC ~ 1/eps^2 (halving eps -> 4x samples); quantum AE ~ 1/eps (halving eps -> ~2x oracle calls)
summary.honest_limits: One oracle call is a deep circuit; on error-corrected hardware it is far slower than one classical sample. Advantage for derivative pricing would require ~4.7k logical qubits executing ~1e9 T-gates at a 45 MHz logical clock rate (Stamatopoulos et al., Quantum 2024, arXiv:2307.14310) -- a required speed far beyond projected error-corrected hardware -- pushing the real crossover to much smaller eps / larger problems. Classical MC also has importance sampling. The quadratic speedup alone is not enough -- which is why finance is not the first quantum priority.
